receipts.detail: first seed bootstrap mints a randomUUID CONFIG-row singleton and never re-mints over an existing identity
both hints builders carry the identity and the persisted value is readable pre-hydration on restart
the identity is written through the replicated CONFIG-row system table writer (EPOCH_CONFIG_KEY precedent)
the snapshot-checkpoint seam reads the durable CONFIG-row identity, falling back to the pre-identity default only while none is visible
a hints/expected cluster-id mismatch resolves to the typed fail-closed CLUSTER_ID_MISMATCH startup decision
